events.region: Bates, MO; Cass, MO; Henry, MO; Johnson, MO; Lafayette, MO
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 456 AM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from near Oak Grove to 6 miles northwest of Montrose,
moving east at 35 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Warrensburg, Holden, Garden City, Urich, Creighton, Chilhowee,
Kingsville, Lake Lafayette, Centerview, Gunn City, Blairstown,
Fayetteville, La Tour, Ballard, Pittsville, Hartwell, La Due, and
Quick City.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Waters from Oregon Inlet to Cape Hatteras NC from 20 to 60 NM; Waters from Cape Hatteras to Ocracoke Inlet NC from 20 to 60 NM
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SMWMHX

The National Weather Service in Newport has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Waters from Cape Hatteras to Ocracoke Inlet NC from 20 to 60 NM...
Waters from Oregon Inlet to Cape Hatteras NC from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 630 AM EDT.

* At 544 AM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located 45 nm southeast of
Diamond Shoals, moving east at 20 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* The strong thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
...The Flood Watch continues for the following rivers in Iowa...

Cedar River at Janesville affecting Black Hawk and Bremer
counties.

Cedar River at Cedar Falls affecting Black Hawk county.

Cedar River at Waterloo affecting Black Hawk county.

* WHAT...Flooding is possible.

* WHERE...The Cedar River at Janesville, or from Quarter Section Run
west of Denver to the West Fork Cedar River.

* WHEN...From Saturday morning to Sunday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 14.0 feet, Water threatens areas of Janesville south
of 8th St.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 3:45 AM CDT Thursday the stage was 3.6 feet.
- Forecast...Flood stage may be reached Saturday morning.
- Flood stage is 13.0 feet.
